August 27th., 40.

1.

PRIVATE HOUSE OCCUPIED BY
S.C.S.P.B. AT 40 JOSEFIELD RD.

（批：D.C. Sp. Branch
Sir
These men
are from "76".
Cuyler
D.I.）

At 3.50p.m. 27/8/40 Sung Siao Ching (沈少卿) employed
as a clerk-of-work by Dau Kwai Sung (陶桂生) a building
contractor, 140/27 Changtu Road, came to the station and
made the following report:

He, Sung Siao Ching was employed on the construc-
tion of the Bank of China building, at the Bund and
Jinkee Road corner and also worked on the construction
of the new building at No. 40 Josefield Road where the
work has been done by his employer.

At about noon 26/8/40 he went to No. 40 Josefield
Road to visit 6 workmen employed there. Shortly after
noon 6 armed men in plain clothes entered the building
which is nearly completed and questioned the workmen as
to the ownership of the house, the firm of building
contractor etc., stating that the house was wanted by
the S.C.S.P.B. Then the informant was told to leave,
as only the workmen employed in the building were allow-
ed to remain on the premises. At 5.30p.m. 26/8/40
the informant went back to No. 40 Josefield Road intend-
ing to remove therefrom his belongings. He was met by
about 10 armed men, who seized him, handcuffed and
again questioned as to the ownership of the house. As
he was unable to give answer to all the questions he
was taken to a small room on the 1st. floor where the

1940年8月27日。

1.

上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处（S.C.S.P.B.）占用
约瑟夫路（Josefield Rd.）40号的私人住宅

（批：D.C. 特别处
先生
这些人
来自“76号”。
Cuyler
督察）

1940年8月27日下午3时50分，受雇于建筑承包商陶桂生（Dau Kwai Sung，地址：长涂路 Changtu Road 140/27号）担任监工的沈少卿（Sung Siao Ching）来到警局，作出如下报告：

沈少卿称，他此前受雇参与位于外滩与江西路（Jinkee Road）转角处的中国银行大楼的施工建设，同时也在其雇主承建的约瑟夫路40号新建筑的工地上工作。

1940年8月26日中午左右，他前往约瑟夫路40号探望在那里工作的6名工人。午后不久，6名身穿便衣、携带武器的男子进入这栋已接近完工的建筑，向工人们询问该房屋的业主、建筑承包商公司等情况，并称该房屋为上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处（S.C.S.P.B.）所需。随后，举报人被告知离开，因为只允许在该建筑内工作的工人留在现场。1940年8月26日下午5时30分，举报人返回约瑟夫路40号，打算取走他的个人物品。他遇到了大约10名携带武器的男子，这些人将他抓住，戴上手铐，并再次就房屋业主一事进行盘问。由于他无法回答所有问题，他被带到一楼的一个小房间，在那里

handcuffs were removed from him, but two armed men
placed to guard him. The informant remained there
till 3p.m. 27/8/40 when he observed that his guards
were sleeping, he then climbed out through a window
and escaped, after which he came to this station and
reported the occurrence.

The informant was not in a position to state who
was actually the owner of the house, which is actually
situated in Chinese Territory, therefore he was
advised to notify his employer who could inform the
owner in order that the proper authorities might be
approached.

D. S. L.

他的手铐被解开，但有两名持枪男子看守着他。举报人一直待在那里，直到1940年8月27日下午3时，他发现看守正在睡觉，于是从窗户爬出逃脱，随后来到本警局报告了此事。

举报人无法说明该房屋的实际业主是谁，鉴于该房屋实际上位于华界，因此建议他通知其雇主，以便雇主告知业主，从而向有关当局提出交涉。
